81:     /**
82:      * Creates sum aggregation properties.
83:      *
84:      * Example:
85:      * ```
86:      * $sum = Aggregate::sum('field_to_aggregate_upon');
87:      * ```
88:      * @param string $field The relative path of the field to aggregate upon.
89:      * @return Aggregate
90:      */

92:     {
93:         $sum = new Aggregate(self::TYPE_SUM);
94:         $sum->setField($field);
95:         return $sum;
96:     }
